tools.name: firmao_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (counterparties) with name, label, NIP, addresses, contacts and customer groups. Supports paging, sorting and filters. Firmao API: GET /svc/v1/customers.

tools.name: firmao_list_contacts
tools.description: List contact persons (people linked to customers) with name, e-mail, phone and company. Firmao API: GET /svc/v1/contacts.

tools.name: firmao_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with name, dates, team members, managers, budget and profit summary. Firmao API: GET /svc/v1/projects.

tools.name: firmao_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks with name, status, priority, project, responsible users, planned dates and estimated hours. Firmao API: GET /svc/v1/tasks.

tools.name: firmao_list_products
tools.description: List products and services with name, price, VAT rate and stock levels. Firmao API: GET /svc/v1/products.

tools.name: firmao_list_transactions
tools.description: List transactions (invoices, receipts, proformas and other sales or purchase documents) with number, counterparty, dates, amounts and payment status. Firmao API: GET /svc/v1/transactions.

tools.name: firmao_list_offers
tools.description: List offers, orders and contracts with number, counterparty, dates and totals. Firmao API: GET /svc/v1/offers.

tools.name: firmao_list_sales_opportunities
tools.description: List sales opportunities (deals in the pipeline) with name, customer, value, stage and expected close date. Firmao API: GET /svc/v1/salesopportunities.

tools.name: firmao_list_sales_notes
tools.description: List sales notes (customer contact history entries) with type, description, customer and date. Firmao API: GET /svc/v1/salesnotes.

tools.name: firmao_list_time_entries
tools.description: List logged work time entries with user, task or project, start and end, and duration. Firmao API: GET /svc/v1/timeentries.

tools.name: firmao_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer (counterparty) in Firmao. Creates a new record in the customer's CRM. Firmao API: POST /svc/v1/customers.

tools.name: firmao_create_project
tools.description: Create a project in Firmao with optional team members and managers. Creates a new record. Firmao API: POST /svc/v1/projects.

tools.name: firmao_create_task
tools.description: Create a task in Firmao, optionally inside a project and with responsible users. Creates a new record. Firmao API: POST /svc/v1/tasks.

tools.name: firmao_create_sales_note
tools.description: Add a sales note (contact history entry) to a customer in Firmao. Creates a new record. Firmao API: POST /svc/v1/salesnotes.
